color_evidence.basis: Estimated visually from the saved official front photograph; not published official HEX or textile color specifications.

observations: Burgundy-red body and sleeves with scattered narrow angular lines and small triangular shards. Triangle vertices and line endpoints were individually transcribed from the official flat front (500px), excluding printed marks, then mapped to the common torso and sleeves. Pale shoulder tapes, red crew neck with thin pale inner edge and plain red cuffs. Colors and graphic coordinates are photo estimates; tiny weave is omitted.
omitted: Club emblems, sponsors, manufacturer logo symbols, lettering, badges and tiny textile weave. Observed garment trim is retained.

research_log.action: Reviewed correct-season official product page and front photographs; traced observed panel layout on the mandatory reference-front-2 master.

visual_review.notes: Compared with complete official flat-front photograph at enlarged size: manually recorded triangle vertices and fine diagonal line endpoints follow observed positions. Refined white neck piping to a fine inner edge. Fine fabric texture and graphics hidden under sponsor marks are not inferred. Original smooth reference-front-2 outline and interpolated original lighting retained. Colors and graphic placement are photo estimates, not official HEX values or pixel-identical reproduction.

png_layout.review_scope: Shoulder geometry, collar and cuff paint adapted against local source photographs. This is not a new kit-season verification or a claim of identical garment construction.
png_layout.changes: Two pale shoulder tapes follow the top edge and end on the upper sleeve; pale collar inner edge restored. Existing angular fabric artwork retained.
png_layout.limitations: Original PNG silhouette, round-neck fabric folds and seams are retained. Painted V/polo trims cannot alter physical construction. Other previously approximated fabric patterns are not certified by this trim review.
